liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Listener claims this is the best China Rider performance in their humble opinion [22]
- **Believe It Or Not** (1 review): Listener calls this the best performance of the song they have ever heard [16]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Described as one of the most powerful renditions of the song ever heard [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-30.akg460.ackerman.andrewf.81533.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd.miller.96071.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 161 min; rated 3.9/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is excellent from Ramble On Rose until the end, and good before that; Charlie's transfer provides very good sound quality for this show [19][20]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd-set2.skankweed.finney.6670.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 101 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [11]. Said about its sound: Performance is slightly sloppy at times but recovers with dazzling abandon and panache [14]
- **gd1988-06-30.145661.fob.akg460.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 157 min [3]

## Around the show

- Jerry goofed with the China Cat riff at the end of I Know You Rider [16]
- A fan near the reviewer caught his arm on fire during a Queen Jane false start [19]
- The minor league stadium venue contributed to the band having fun and being on [21]
- Phil was really thumping on this night, according to the listener [22]
- Rain stopped magically as the band started playing Box of Rain [25]
- Jerry teased Deal before the song Queen Jane Approximately [1]
- Green Onions was the first and only time the song was performed [3]
- Green Onions was the first and only time the song was performed [4]
- The second set is considered a gem overall despite the earlier roughness [14]
- Reviewer considers this the best show from the Alpine through Rochester tour leg [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-30.akg460.ackerman.andrewf.81533.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Andrew F; source: AKG 460's with CK3 hypercardioid capsules > Sony TC-D5M. Set up FOB, even with the front of the board. [1]. Also: Tape flips were patched using segments from ShnID-414 with Soundforge [1]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd.miller.96071.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D5/Dolby B); Set 2: SBD -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [2]. Also: This transfer is a significant upgrade over the previously circulating Gans source; FOB recording used Schoeps CMC5/MK21 mics into PCM then DAT [2][17]
- **gd1988-06-30.sbd-set2.skankweed.finney.6670.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>Sonic Solutions>CDR [11]
- **gd1988-06-30.145661.fob.akg460.ackerman.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Ray Ackerman; transferred by Joe Noel; source: Ray Ackerman's Master Audience Cassette Recording & Transfer; AKG 460 w/ck63 caps > AKG B18 phantom power unit > Sony D5 > Master Cassette. Located, front left… [3]
